review_description: When it comes right down to making a decision, it's hard, so many different systems and companies to choose from. Even with all your help via your articles and blogs your recommended suppliers etc. the choice is difficult. Thanks once again for providing this great service.
Sunelec fitted our off grid system over 10 years ago and still provide us with support when needed. Brilliant service!

We are getting approx 15 KW a day & as it is winter we expect to get about 20 KW the same as my husband's work mate. We got the 230 Watt German Panels with a German SMA Inverter. Energex connected us to the grid about 1 month afer we got the system installed. Sunelec organised all the paperwork for grid connection.

The information provided from your website was very informative and useful.I received the names of three  suppliers as promised.I was not impressed with one supplier who rang from Adelaide and spent the first 5 minutes trying to pressure me into making a decision before even telling me what he had to offer.  He was later helpful in answering my questions but overall it was not a "nice shopping experience"The second supplier emailed me brochures to look at.  It was difficult to get more information from them although they emailed me on occassions for a decision.I didn't heard from the third supplier.The supplier I used was local. They came out to look at the site and explain everything in detail.  Service was good and I'm happy with the results so far.
Very smooth no fuss no hassles from either side.
